raw_text: Three crew members have been killed in a Houthi missile attack on the bulk carrier True Confidence in the Gulf of Aden, marking the deadliest assault on commercial shipping since the Yemen-based group began its campaign in November. The attack underscores the growing threat to one of the world's busiest shipping lanes, through which much of India's trade with Europe and the Middle East passes. Houthi spokesman Yahya Sarea claimed the attack was in response to the ongoing war in Gaza.
clean_text: Three killed in Houthi missile attack on True Confidence in Gulf of Aden, deadliest assault on commercial shipping since November campaign began. Attack threatens shipping lane vital to India-Europe trade.
